build_positional_encoding: build a PositionalEncoding instance and initialize it with n_freqs to encode input tensors using sin and cos frequency bands
create_no_encoding: create a NoEncoding instance that passes input tensors through unchanged without any transformation
test_get_encoding: test the FeatureEncoding.get_encoding class method to retrieve PositionalEncoding or NoEncoding by name string
review_num_features: review the FeatureEncoding.num_features class method to calculate output feature dimensions for nerf or none encoding
run_encode: run the encode method on a PositionalEncoding instance to transform a tensor with learned frequency band functions
